description: Which ontology rules the running application actually enforces. 'runtime' means a contract test executes the real code path and it rejects the bad case, within the stated scope. 'offline_only' means only tools/validate_ontology.py checks it, against fixtures; no live workflow calls the validator. 'planned' means the application does not do this today. A contract can pass and still leave its shape 'offline_only' when no deployed caller of that code is established.

sources.reason: A relationship row cannot hold 'deprecated'; only an entity row can. Tracked in #5523.
Tag rows have no deprecated state.
Wiring rows have no deprecated state.

sources.name: KG_APPROVAL_STATES
sources.reason: The engine-side writer never emits 'deprecated' (ADR-0017 supersede leaves the row unchanged). Tracked in #5523.
The live-snapshot decoder uses three bands of its own; it never reports 'bad' or 'uncertain' and calls an undecodable tag 'unknown'. No tracking issue yet; listed as a remaining gap in #5528.

stale-drive-data-gives-no-diagnosis.rule: A reading taken while drive comms are lost is not used for a live diagnosis or a numeric claim.
stale-drive-data-gives-no-diagnosis.call_path: mira-bots/shared/engine.py -> live_snapshot.normalize + render_machine_evidence -> build_drive_diagnostic; mira-pipeline/ignition_chat.py -> live_snapshot.assess_from_paths -> build_drive_diagnostic; mira-bots/ask_api/app.py -> normalize + render_status_block

fault-code-answer-is-scoped-to-one-drive.rule: A fault code is answered only from the one drive family the question resolved to; two families in one question is refused.
fault-code-answer-is-scoped-to-one-drive.call_path: mira-bots/ask_api/drive_pack.py and mira-bots/shared/engine.py -> drive_packs.ask.answer_question; mira-bots/shared/chat/fast_paths.py -> resolve_service_pack

command-is-not-feedback.rule: A RUN command is never taken as proof the motor is running; the two are separate tags and a mismatch is reported.
command-is-not-feedback.call_path: The gateway endpoint ignition/webdev/FactoryLM/api/diagnose/doGet.py calls a vendored copy, diagnose_core.evaluate (the test runs both the source and the copy). No DEPLOYED caller is established: the WebDev module is not installed on the bench gateway, so that endpoint does not answer today.

approval-state-vocabulary-is-a-database-.rule: A graph row cannot carry an approval state outside the allowed set.
approval-state-vocabulary-is-a-database-.call_path: PostgreSQL CHECK constraint on kg_entities / kg_relationships (every writer)

asset-agent-approval-needs-a-named-perso.rule: An asset agent cannot be approved without a named human actor.
asset-agent-approval-needs-a-named-perso.call_path: simlab/approval.py -> validate_transition; mira-pipeline/ignition_chat.py -> gate_decision. The Hub route api/assets/[id]/agent-status/transition uses the TypeScript twin, which this test does not execute; the same rule is asserted there by mira-hub/src/lib/asset-agent-transition.test.ts ('approved requires a human actor'), run by the Hub Unit Tests CI job.

superseded-fact-leaves-the-verified-set.rule: A superseded assertion must not remain verified (R14c).
superseded-fact-leaves-the-verified-set.call_path: apply_kg_approval(trigger='supersede') issues no write; readers filter approval_state = 'verified'. The only importer of proposal_transition.py outside tests is demo/factory_difference_engine/pipeline.py, so no production path applies this transition at all. The Hub twin agrees with the Python side: mira-hub/src/lib/proposal-transition.test.ts asserts supersede sets the suggestion to 'superseded' and the proposal to 'deprecated', and writes no graph approval state, so the Hub path has the same gap.

fault-code-identity-includes-the-model.rule: Two models' fault codes are different things even when the code text matches (model vs installed-instance identity, R4).
fault-code-identity-includes-the-model.call_path: mira-crawler ingest -> kg_writer.register_fault_code -> upsert_entity keyed (tenant, type, name)

reader-sees-the-relationship-name-approv.rule: An approved relationship must be visible to the reader that is meant to use it.
reader-sees-the-relationship-name-approv.call_path: Source-level check only: the test reads both TypeScript files and compares the names; it does not execute them. Hub proposal approval stores the canonical name; traversal.ts filters on the lowercase one.

BooleanNotQuantityShape.nearest_runtime: tag_events.value_type CHECK fixes the type vocabulary only

CommandNotFeedbackShape.nearest_runtime: CV-101 anomaly rule A6 keeps the run command and run feedback apart and the contract test passes on it, but the gateway endpoint that would run it is not installed, so no live workflow is protected today

LiveDiagnosisEligibilityShape.scope: GS10 live-snapshot path, when a turn carries live tags; only the comms-lost case. There is no age-based staleness check

MeasurementCompletenessShape.nearest_runtime: tag_events NOT NULL columns and quality CHECK

ReadOnlyPolicyShape.nearest_runtime: materialized_evidence.context_contract.validate_context rejects write-shaped actions, but its flag MIRA_CONTEXT_CONTRACT is off by default; mira-bots/tests/test_drive_packs_readonly.py is a static CI gate

StaleCommsNumericClaimShape.scope: GS10 live-snapshot path, when a turn carries live tags

AssetClassInstanceShape.reason: The graph writer keys a fault code by manufacturer and code text, so two models merge into one identity.

DriveFamilyIdentityShape.nearest_runtime: drive_packs resolver refuses a manufacturer-only question

FaultAppliedToWrongFamilyShape.scope: Drive-pack answers only. The knowledge-graph path does not enforce it (#5520)

ParameterCardCitationShape.nearest_runtime: drive_packs loader; not verified by a contract test

PromotedSymbolNeedsHumanShape.nearest_runtime: wiring_connections.approval_state CHECK and the wiring_profile trusted() filter; not verified by a contract test

ApprovedAssertionEvidenceShape.nearest_runtime: No database constraint requires an approver, a timestamp or a citation on a verified graph row

AssertionShape.scope: The approval_state vocabulary only, on kg_entities and kg_relationships (each table has its own allowed set). The shape's other constraints, such as confidence range, are offline only

InferenceCannotSelfApproveShape.nearest_runtime: asset_agent_transition requires a named actor for asset-agent approval (contract asset-agent-approval-needs-a-named-person); nothing equivalent guards a graph assertion

MachineVerifiedIsNotApprovedShape.nearest_runtime: printsense TrustState keeps machine_verified and human_verified apart; the graph tables have one flat 'verified'

SupersededNotCurrentShape.reason: Readers admit any verified row without checking supersession.

SupersededStateShape.reason: The supersede transition leaves the graph row verified, and a relationship row cannot hold 'deprecated'.
